verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਰਤਨ ਅਮੋਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: maan sarovar saadhasa(n)g maanak motee ratan amolaa|

en.bdb: Manasarovar (lake) in the form of holy congregation contains in it many invaluable rubies, pearls and jewels.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੰਸੀ ਪਰਮਹੰਸ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਡੋਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh va(n)see paramaha(n)s sabadh surat gurmat addolaa|

en.bdb: Gurmukhs too belong to the family of swans of highest order who merging their consciousness in the Word remain stabilized.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖੀਰਹੁ ਨੀਰ ਨਿਕਾਲਦੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਨਿਰੋਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: kheerahu neer nikaaladhe gurmukh giaan dhiaan nirolaa|

en.bdb: Due to their power of knowledge and meditiation, the gurmukhs sift milk from water (i.e. truth from falsehood).

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਤੋਲੁ ਨ ਤੋਲਨਹਾਰੁ ਅਤੋਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sach salaaheeaai tol na tolanahaar atolaa|

en.bdb: Eulogising the truth, gurmukhs become incomparable and their glory cannot be measured by any one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਹੈ ਘੁਟਿ ਘੁਟਿ ਜੀਆਂ ਖਾਇ ਅਬੋਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: manmukh bagul samaadh hai ghuT ghuT jeeaa(n) khai abolaa|

en.bdb: Manmukh, the mind-oriented, is like a crane who silently strangulates the creatures and eats them up.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਲਖਾਉ ਟਿਕਾਇ ਜਾਇ ਛਪੜਿ ਊਹੁ ਪੜੈ ਮੁਹਚੋਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: hoi lakhaau Tikai jai chhapaR uooh paRai muhacholaa|

en.bdb: Seeing it sitting at a pond, the creatures therein create an uproar and cries of distress.
Truth is noble whereas falsehood is lowly slave.
